snippet.title: Irezumi Defenders Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4053750/Irezumi_Defenders/

Irezumi Defenders is a tower defense game where you build your units in a world inspired by Japanese mythology. Stack cards to craft buildings, gather resources, and produce units to protect your kingdom from Yokai! 👺
